summary: Ford Credit Floorplan LLC and Ford Credit Floorplan Corporation, as depositors for Ford Credit Floorplan Master Owner Trust A, filed an 8-K reporting a routine takedown of asset-backed notes under a prospectus dated October 6, 2026. The filing satisfies an undertaking to deliver unqualified legality and tax opinions from Katten Muchin Rosenman LLP at each takedown; no deal terms, prices, stakes, or board recommendations are disclosed. This is an ordinary ABS shelf issuance, not a special situation; watch only for standard note terms and collateral performance.
